newsitem.title: USA: Ocean Energy says receives requisite tender.
newsitem.headline: Ocean Energy says receives requisite tender.

text.p: Ocean Energy Inc said Monday it has received sufficient tenders and consents from the holders of outstanding 13-1/2 percent senior notes due 2004 to effect the proposed amendments of its related indenture.

Last month, Ocean Energy announced a cash tender offer and consent solicitation relating to this issue. Under the terms of the offer, holders who properly tender their senior notes and deliver the related consents by July 15 will be entitled to receive the total consideration, which includes a consent payment of $10.00 per $1,000 principal amount of notes.
Holders who properly tender their senior notes and deliver related consents after that time will be entitled to receive the balance of the total consideration being offered.
The tender offer for the senior notes expires July 21.
